question:
**Select the option with the correct spellings to replace the underlined words in the given sentence.**

His __charesmatic__ attitude is __admirble__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Charismatic; admirable**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**charismatic**", with a "**ch**" instead of a "**k**".
 
• The word "**charismatic**" means having a compelling charm or attractiveness that inspires devotion in others. (एक सम्मोहक आकर्षण या आकर्षण होना जो दूसरों में भक्ति को प्रेरित करता है)
 
 
• **Example**: *His charismatic personality effortlessly drew people in, making him a natural leader in the group.*
 
 
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**admirable**", with an "**i**" instead of an "**e**".
 
• The word "**admirable**" means deserving respect or approval; excellent. (सम्मान या अनुमोदन के योग्य; उत्कृष्ट)
 
 
• **Example**: *Her dedication to community service is truly admirable, inspiring others to contribute to the well-being of society.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
